beats.headline: THE ORDER
beats.text: Nariman House, 2008. A voice on a phone from Pakistan: pile the mattresses at the top of the stairs.

beats.headline: THE CHIEF PLANNER
beats.text: The FBI calls him the chief planner of 26/11. His name is Sajid Mir.

beats.headline: DEAD, ON PAPER
beats.text: Then Pakistan let the world believe he was dead.

beats.headline: RESURRECTED
beats.text: Until a financial watchdog needed proof. Arrested. Convicted. Never for Mumbai.

beats.headline: THE VOICE IN THE ROOM
beats.text: The Voice in the Room. Now on The Sisodia Files.
